skills.tier_1: Understand and define terms such as displacement, velocity, acceleration, and time.
skills.tier_2: Apply definitions to identify these quantities in various physical scenarios.

skills.skill: Differentiate between scalar and vector quantities
skills.tier_1: Recognize the difference between scalar and vector quantities.
skills.tier_2: Classify physical quantities as scalar or vector in complex problems.

capstone.heading: Bringing it together
capstone.body: Create a glossary of kinematic terms with examples illustrating scalar and vector quantities.

skills.tier_1: Understand the derivation of the three equations of motion for uniformly accelerated linear motion.
skills.tier_2: Apply the equations to solve problems involving objects in linear motion.

skills.skill: Solve problems using equations of motion
skills.tier_1: Identify which equation of motion to use for a given problem.
skills.tier_2: Solve complex problems involving multiple steps and variables using equations of motion.

capstone.heading: Bringing it together
capstone.body: Solve a comprehensive problem set that involves deriving and applying equations of motion to real-world scenarios.

skills.tier_1: Identify and describe motion from position-time, velocity-time, and acceleration-time graphs.
skills.tier_2: Analyze and interpret complex motion graphs to determine motion characteristics.

skills.tier_1: Sketch basic motion graphs from given data or descriptions.
skills.tier_2: Create detailed motion graphs that accurately represent complex motion scenarios.

capstone.heading: Bringing it together
capstone.body: Analyze a set of motion graphs to determine the type of motion and create a narrative description of the motion.

skills.skill: Understand the components of projectile motion
skills.tier_1: Describe the horizontal and vertical components of projectile motion.
skills.tier_2: Analyze projectile motion by separating it into horizontal and vertical components.

skills.tier_1: Apply basic equations to solve simple projectile motion problems.
skills.tier_2: Solve complex projectile motion problems involving multiple variables and constraints.

capstone.heading: Bringing it together
capstone.body: Design and solve a real-world problem involving projectile motion, considering both horizontal and vertical components.
